## LocalAsrCapabilities.available property

True when the host has a model configured. False means the applet should not attempt `openSession()` — it will reject. Note that `weaveClient.localModels` may itself be undefined when the applet lacks the permission; this field only flips false when the host is present but unconfigured.

**Signature:**

```typescript
available: boolean;
```
